messages:
Marta S: Quick heads-up — an external assessor requested a pre-PT dry-run next Tue. We need a slim playbook for access windows, RBAC temporary roles, and KMS-safe evidence exports. Who can lead the package?
Alex P: I can own the temp RBAC role work. Need list of principals + service accounts. Can someone confirm scope (staging only vs staging+canary)? ETA EOD?
Marta S: Staging-only. No prod creds. Presigned S3 links for logs and a signed export for any KMS-protected material. 24h review window for uploaded evidence.
Jen R: For audit logs: snapshot retention + example queries. Plan: CloudTrail -> S3 (immutable snapshot), sample Athena queries, and a kubernetes audit event dump. Presigned links should expire in <=72h.
Ryan L: Can we use ephemeral sessions via our SSO proxy to avoid issuing long-lived keys? Also need a 30-min handoff with the assessor to confirm allowed actions.
Devsec-bot: Reminder: create evidence bucket with tags: {"purpose":"pt-evidence"} and lifecycle: 90d->archive, 365d->delete. Notify team when bucket ready.
Marta S: Good call. Alex, propose role names and minimal policies. Jen, can you draft the CloudTrail/Athena snippets? Put everything into the triage doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/pt/triage-252468
Alex P: Proposed role names: pt_assessor_temp and pt_assessor_readonly. Minimal policy example (note: avoid Decrypt unless absolutely required):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket"], "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence/*"]},
    {"Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["sts:AssumeRole"], "Resource": ["arn:aws:iam::123:role/pt_assessor_temp"]}
  ]
}
```
Alex P: If the assessor insists on KMS-wrapped material, we can provide signed, sealed exports rather than plaintext decrypt. Ops can produce the export.
Jen R: CloudTrail example lookup: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=ConsoleLogin` and an Athena query to filter by principal. I'll add kubectl audit dump example too.
Marta S: On KMS — ops should avoid sharing DEKs. Ryan, can your team sign/export with a detached signature instead of giving decrypt?
Ryan L: Yes — we can generate a zipped archive, sign it with our KMS sign key, and provide the signature+archive. Assessor can verify integrity without access to keys. We'll document verification steps.
Alex P: For temporal access: use SSO with self-expiring sessions. Propose 8h default window for the dry-run. Any escalation requests go to Marta or Jen for approval.
Marta S: Approvals noted. Also: pre-dry-run checklist: 1) Create temp roles 2) Provision presigned S3 links + signed export 3) Enable audit snapshot + sample queries 4) Handoff call 5) Capture any scope escalation in triage doc. I'll draft the runbook in 30m.
Jen R: Retest/resync slots: Wed 09:00-11:00 or Thu 13:00-16:00. I'll reserve both in calendar and add a brief agenda.
Ryan L: Add a canary monitor to abort exports if traffic/noise spikes > X. Also add rate-limit rules so assessor scans don't trigger escalations.
Marta S: I'll ping legal for minimal NDA language and confirm assessor identity before issuing access. We'll tag the triage ticket for audit. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
